title: Decide fate of held PR #109 (Autonomous SOC -> Autonomous Triage rename)
description: PR #109 on codex/issue-94-autonomous-soc is explicitly held: 'Do not mark this PR ready or merge it as-is.' Naming review rejected 'Autonomous SOC' in favour of 'Autonomous Triage'; the approved run and evidence identity are bound to the autonomous-soc slug, so a replacement content-bound evaluation is required rather than a retitle. This branch is why Ratchet MCD-TBD-1 reports a 15.2-day gap - a false positive, since branch age cannot distinguish a held PR from an abandoned one. Either run the replacement evaluation under the new slug, or close #109 and delete the branch. Part of #94.

title: Refresh 6 drifted evidence records blocking the weekly Adoption Evidence run
description: tests/test_evidence_content.py::test_complete_evidence_quotes_still_present fails on the weekly schedule (run 33392354316, tracked by issue #94). Six complete-provenance records drifted: agent-hooks[0] (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks reworded the quoted sentence to add 'MCP tool calls' and 'subagents' - verified live), custom-commands[1] (code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/slash-commands was replaced by the 'Extend agents with skills' page; the quoted sentence is gone and the source no longer supports the claim as recorded - verified live), incident-automation[0] (github.com/akmatori/akmatori README changed), autonomous-soc[1] (dropzone.ai marketing copy changed), long-running-orchestration[0] (developers.openai.com/codex/cloud), and planned-implementation[2] (VS Code docs redirect /docs/agents/planning -> /docs/agents/run/planning; per issue #119 the quote is still live and only resolved_url moved). Authoring a replacement mechanism_quote is an evidence-authoring act, so this needs the local Codex evaluation flow (plan -> APPROVE LOCAL EVALUATION -> research -> hydrate -> publication approval), not a hand edit. Issue #119 records that hydrate-evidence-content.py has no safe standalone mode, so fixing planned-implementation[2] alone is still blocked on that.
